DeleteAll.Title: Delete all transitions
DeleteAll.ConfirmBody: Delete all {count} transitions? This cannot be undone.

Menu.DeleteConfirm: Delete the transition "{name}"? This cannot be undone.

Editor.Title: Fade & Cue — Edit Transition
Editor.DirectionLabel: Direction (used only by Slide and Wipe)
Editor.BackgroundEffectHint: Fade away: the background fades out while the text stays; its delay and duration are in the Timing tab. Soft edges: the background turns transparent toward the borders. Vignette: the background is transparent in the middle and solid at the borders.
Editor.SceneWarning: This transition has a see-through background and changes scene, so players can see the map change behind it.
Editor.FadeAwayHint: The background starts fading this long after the screen is covered. The hold is extended if needed, so the fade finishes before the text leaves.
Editor.AutoMatchAudioLabel: Match hold time to audio length
Editor.ContentHint: Select some text, then use the toolbar to format it.
Editor.SceneDelayWarning: The scene change delay (set in the module settings) is longer than the hold time: the transition will end before the scene changes, and players will see the switch.

Directory.Empty: No transitions saved yet. Create one with the button above.

Debug.Name: Enable debug logging
Debug.Hint: Writes detailed information to the browser console (F12) for you and your players, to help troubleshooting. Player consoles show only each transition's title, never its content. Leave it off during normal play.

Volume.Name: Default audio volume
Volume.Hint: Base volume (0 to 1) for transition audio. Each user's own Music volume applies on top.

SceneDelay.Name: Scene change delay (ms)
SceneDelay.Hint: How long after the screen is fully covered the GM's client switches to the linked scene. Raise it if players sometimes see the map change before the transition covers their screen.

Diagnostics.Name: Diagnostics
Diagnostics.Label: Run diagnostics
Diagnostics.Hint: Checks the module and its setup, then shows a report to attach to bug reports. Nothing is changed.

FADECUE.GMOnly: Fade & Cue: only the GM can send transitions to players.

Io.InvalidFile: Fade & Cue: that file isn't a transition Fade & Cue can read.
Io.ImportedWithWarning: Imported "{name}" — some referenced files are missing, see the chat message for details.
Io.MissingAssetsIntro: Fade & Cue: importing "{name}" went fine, but the following could not be found on this server:

FADECUE.TransitionNotFound: Fade & Cue: that transition could not be found (it may have just been deleted).

Diagnostics.Title: Fade & Cue — Diagnostics
Diagnostics.Intro: Read-only checks: nothing is saved, sent or changed. Copy or download the report and attach it to your bug report.
Diagnostics.Copied: Diagnostics report copied to the clipboard.
